description: Use this when the user wants to keep a session to come back to: save this, add it to my list, favourite it. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code (en, es, pt-BR, fr, it, ja, hi, ko, hu, or any other such as pl). Always pass the language the user writes in. If the language is not available the answer says so and gives the closest live one. hi, ko and hu are beta.

session_id.description: The session id from find_sessions or play_session.

tap.description: The token from keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.

name: save_session
title: Save a session
